definitions.sourceFingerprint: SHA-256 of TypeScript scanner tokens after removing comments and trivia; identifiers and literals are preserved.
definitions.exactProjectClone: Projects with the same multiset of source-file token fingerprints.
definitions.boilerplateFile: A source fingerprint appearing in at least 51 projects (5% of the corpus).
definitions.nearProjectClone: Connected component of project pairs with Jaccard similarity >= 0.80 over non-boilerplate file fingerprints and at least two shared non-boilerplate files.
